profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer II at Microsoft in NYC working on Security: maintaining our customers and Microsoft itself secure from cyber-attacks by providing Threat Intelligence and hardening solutions.

My current role is creating AI Agents and MCP tools that provide security for our customers. I've done this by developing in Security Copilot and using the GitHub Copilot and Claude Agent SDK. 

I have experience developing in .NET, Python, Java, and Web development in Angular and Vue.js and using and constructing REST APIs. In web development, I have experience as a full-stack engineer working both in the front-end and back-end of the services.

While an undergraduate student in the University of Puerto Rico in Mayaguez, I interned for 6 months in INFOX GmbH & Co at Troisdorf, Germany. There, I created an Angular Web Application in a group of four interns under the SCRUM framework to improve the company's product-creation processes and experience. During my studies, I also worked for two years with Vue.js and created a Full-Stack application to help new students meet with mentors, set goals, and keep track of grades each semester. Leadwas an instructor for the Database Systems class in UPRM, and was the Clarinet Section Leader in the UPRM Marching Band for three years.

I have full professional proficiency in English and Spanish and am born and raised in Puerto Rico. Currently living in New Jersey, US.
